# ADR-####: <short title>

**Status:** Proposed | Accepted | Superseded · **Date:** YYYY-MM-DD

## Context
Why this decision is needed — the problem, constraints, and options considered (2-4 sentences).

## Decision
What we decided, concretely (named components, config, contracts).

## Consequences
- Positive: what this unlocks.
- Negative/trade-offs: what this costs or defers.
- Supersedes: link to any replaced ADR.

---
*Rules: ≤400 words · one ADR per decision · decisions before code · status changes via edits. Normative requirements use RFC 2119 keywords (MUST/SHOULD/MAY + uppercase). Style: `docs/standards/writing-guide.md`.*
